labelChirho: take down (physically, from cross or height)
descriptionChirho: To take down or remove a body from an elevated position, especially taking down from the cross (Mark 15:36, 15:46; Luke 23:53; Acts 13:29); physical lowering or removal.
To pull down or depose from a position of authority or power — 'He has brought down rulers from their thrones' (Luke 1:52); divine action of humbling the exalted.

To demolish, tear down, or destroy buildings, temples, strongholds, or nations — 'I will tear down my barns' (Luke 12:18); destroying arguments (2 Cor 10:5); destroyed seven nations (Acts 13:19); the temple of Artemis being destroyed (Acts 19:27).
